questions: Should the random integer generation be inclusive of both endpoints of value_range (i.e., random.randint style) or exclusive of the upper bound?
Is the order of rows in the output DataFrame required to match the order of CATEGORIES exactly, or is any permutation acceptable as long as all categories appear?
Should the function reset or seed the random number generator to ensure reproducibility, or is that left to the caller?
If value_range is invalid (e.g., lower > upper), should the function raise an error, return an empty DataFrame, or handle it somehow?
Are the counts required to be integers, or could they be floats if value_range includes non-integer endpoints?
Is the function expected to work for any iterable of categories beyond the hardcoded CATEGORIES list, or is it fixed to that list?
Should the DataFrame index be reset to a default RangeIndex, or is preserving the original index from construction acceptable?
If value_range is a single number instead of a tuple, should it be interpreted as (0, that number) or raise an error?
